newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex sees PLN 34 mln '97 group pre-tax.
newsitem.headline: Budimex sees PLN 34 mln '97 group pre-tax.

text.p: Polish construction firm Budimex SA expects to make a group pre-tax profit of 33.7 million zlotys this year, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.
Budimex, which has yet to release full group figures on 1996, made a 39.4-million-zloty pre-tax profit in 1995.

The statement said the Budimex parent company would make a pre-tax profit of 25.7 million zlotys this year. The parent company made a pre-tax profit of 17.4 million zlotys over the first 11 months of 1996.
The statement also said group sales would rise by 44.9 percent this year to 645 million zlotys and that parent sales would rise 56.8 percent to 432.4 million zlotys.

It said the company would be helped in 1997 by likely better weather conditions, no problems seen in work on major contracts such as the Gdansk sewage system, and an improvement of the financial conditions of contracts in former Soviet countries.
